reviewNote: Review 2026-11-04 from a paired visual sweep of all 12 paper and 33 scheme pages (paper pages 10-12 are blank; scheme pages 1-3 are the SEC cover, a blank page and the title page with the index and support notes, and page 33 the back cover; scheme page numbers here are the PDF’s, one ahead of the printed ones; this scheme prints no Summary of Mark Allocations, so every tariff is read beside its part; its cover prints the level in capitals, ORDINARY LEVEL, so its scheme file was built with the appenders’ cover check pointed at the file). The old-syllabus paper: Section A nine short questions (answer six), Section B eight long questions (answer four) numbered 1-8 again, keyed B1-B8 as the Atlas numbers them. 65 routes for 74 printed asks (12 Section A + 62 Section B), 20 raw directive lines classified. Every stem and ask is sliced from the paper and every marking point from the scheme (econ_2010_ol.py). Section A Q1(i)-(ii) and Q3(i)-(iii), and Section B Q5(a)(i)-(iii), Q6(a)(i)-(iii) and Q8(c)(i)-(iii) are one card each, as the scheme prices them together. Section B Q6(b) is printed “(i) Name ... (i) Discuss ... (ii) Outline ...”, an SEC misprint; the scheme numbers the three parts (i)-(iii) and so does the reader, so the cards cite (b)(i)-(iii). Section A Q4 and Q9 print one total over their answer without dividing it, so each is a questionTotal card. No printed choice is credited with a list for each side.
